page_title: GEN 2-0 BOL | Genoa v Bologna 24/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Close effort! Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
90+3' The referee blows his whistle as Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) was too aggressive in his challenge. Genoa are awarded the free kick.
90+2' The ratio of the ball possession is 26:74.

90+1' Unbelievable miss! Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.

90+1' Federico Ravaglia makes a brilliant save! Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
88' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniele Sommariva (Genoa) is coming onto the pitch as Nicola Leali cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Federico Ravaglia and he is replaced by Nicola Bagnolini (Bologna).
86' The substitution is prepared. Tommaso Corazza (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lorenzo De Silvestri.
84' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
81' The total number of attempts is 11:9.
80' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' The resulting corner from Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

78' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Johan Vasquez (Genoa). Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
77' Substitution. Vitinha walks off the pitch and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
77' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Giorgio Cittadini is replaced by Alan Matturro (Genoa).
75' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
73' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
71' Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
70' Here's the change. Alexis Saelemaekers leaves the pitch and Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) comes on as a substitute.
67' Nicola Leali (Genoa) gets a yellow card. The referee Alberto Santoro made the right call.
67' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
65' Vitinha (Genoa) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
64' Santiago Castro (Bologna) attempts to discuss the decision with Alberto Santoro, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
63' Here is a change. Ruslan Malinovsky is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Strootman (Genoa).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Djed Spence (Genoa) comes onto the pitch for Stefano Sabelli.
62' Bologna are ruled offside.
61' Substitution. Riccardo Orsolini will be replaced by Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
60' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Giovanni Fabbian will be replaced by Kacper Urbanski (Bologna).
59' 2 - 0 Goal! Albert Gudmundsson gets to the ball, slips Vitinha (Genoa) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 2:0.
58' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
57' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort goes towards the middle of the goal. Not a big deal for the goalkeeper.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) was quite harsh and Alberto Santoro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
52' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Nicola Leali.
50' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
50' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner.
49' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.

45+1' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alberto Santoro with no other option than to blow for a foul. Genoa will take a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is repeatedly being caught offside.
41' What a big chance! Vitinha (Genoa) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
41' Vitinha (Genoa) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
40' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
38' Santiago Castro (Bologna) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' A lofted cross from Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
34' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
33' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. It's a throw-in for Genoa.
31' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alberto Santoro saw the whole situation.
31' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
29' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
28' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is penalised for a foul. Alberto Santoro had a clear view and blows his whistle.

27' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Morten Thorsby (Genoa) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Federico Ravaglia pulls off a brilliant save.
26' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the right post!
25' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
24' Vitinha (Genoa) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Now Genoa have a corner.
21' Dangerous play by Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna). Alberto Santoro blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
21' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

19' Sam Beukema (Bologna) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
19' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
18' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) passes the ball onto Giovanni Fabbian, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
13' 1 - 0 Fabulous goal. Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) collects an exquisite pass and subsequently produces a low shot from the edge of the box which goes in off the right post.
11' Good clearance! Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
8' Santiago Castro (Bologna) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
7' A pass by Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
5' A poor mid-range free-kick by Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
4' Alberto Santoro blows for a foul after Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Genoa.
2' Aaron Martin (Genoa) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
2' The referee points to the corner flag and Genoa will take a corner.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bologna will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alberto Santoro.
